$comment: Atlas Vector Search index for the `chunks` collection.
This file is the CANONICAL definition. It is applied by `npm run db:indexes`
(src/db/indexes.ts) to Atlas Local and to cloud Atlas identically. Never create
or edit this index by hand in the Atlas UI — the UI is not the source of truth.
numDimensions is overridden at apply time from EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS so the
index always matches the configured model. The value below is the shipped
Every `filter` path is a field a search may narrow on. $vectorSearch can ONLY
filter on paths declared here, which is why chunks denormalise their parent's
tags/contentType. `embeddingModel` is a filter so a re-embedding backfill can
search old and new vectors separately while it runs.
